description: Sprint and circuit rewards: rep and cash by level, rank, time, perfect start and top speed; level-ups.

steps.note: User 1 registers, which logs in too: launcher token ...0001.
Perfect start, top speed and final bonuses for the sprint's rewards. Static data: restored in the last step.
sql: UPDATE event_reward SET perfectStartRepMultiplier = 0.25, perfectStartCashMultiplier = 0.5, topSpeedRepMultiplier = 0.15, topSpeedCashMultiplier = 0.35, finalRepRewardMultiplier = 0.3, finalCashRewardMultiplier = 0.1 WHERE ID = '22_generic'

steps.note: First in the sprint, with a perfect start and over the top-speed trigger, inside the time limit.
Level 2. The result said no level-up: it's worked out after the rep is added.
Third, slower than the time limit: the time bonus shrinks.
Eighth: the lowest rank with a multiplier, at exactly the top-speed trigger.
The same session again: already completed.
